help.subtitle: Common questions about how the app works, explained in a few words.

profiles.title: What is a profile?
profiles.text: Each profile is for someone you care for — yourself, a child, a patient. Each profile has its own medicines, schedules and history, kept separate from the others.

doseStatus.title: What does each dose status mean?
doseStatus.text: Taken: you marked it as taken. Missed: the time passed and nobody marked it — no worries, it's just a heads up. Skipped: you decided on purpose not to take that dose. Pending: the time hasn't come yet.

sharedCare.title: How does shared care work?
sharedCare.text: You can invite someone else (a child, another caregiver) to also see and log doses for a profile. On the Profile screen, tap the person icon next to a name to generate a code. Send that code to them — they use the "I have a code" button, also on the Profile screen.

stock.title: How does stock work?
stock.text: Every medicine already comes with a stock counter. On the Stock screen, tap "Edit": use "Add" to add a new purchase to what you already have, or "Set" to correct the exact number after recounting. The app warns you automatically when it's running low.

appearance.title: Font, theme and language
appearance.text: In Profile → Appearance you can make the text larger (Normal, Large or Extra), switch between light and dark, and change the app's language.

settingUpForSomeoneElse.title: I'm setting this up for someone else
settingUpForSomeoneElse.text: It's fine to do the first setup (profile, medicines, schedules) for someone who'll have trouble doing it themselves. Then leave the phone ready for their day-to-day: just tapping "Taken" or "Skipped" when they take a medicine. Use the "Share guide" button below to send a simple summary by WhatsApp, or to print it out.

help.shareHint: Sends a simple summary via WhatsApp (or any other app), to leave with whoever will use Assídua day to day.
help.shareText:
Quick guide — Assídua

1. When you take your medicine on time, tap "Taken".
2. If it shows "Missed", it's just because the time passed without marking it — not an error, just a heads up.
3. To see how much medicine is left, go to the Stock tab.
4. If you have a question, just open Profile → Help inside the app.
